source_title: Docker Desktop release notes: 4.71.0
claim_summary: Release notes state Docker Model Runner is now disabled by default and list a fix for CVE-2026-5843 (container-to-host code execution in the Model Runner MLX inference backend)
feature: local model runtime default-off; MLX backend fix
limitation: Vendor release note; affected range (4.56.0 to before 4.71.0, macOS MLX) comes from third-party CVE aggregators and heise, not exercised here

source_title: Docker Engine 29 release notes: 29.4.2
claim_summary: Default seccomp profile blocked AF_ALG sockets and socketcall(2) as CVE-2026-31431 (Copy Fail) hardening; notes warn this can break 32-bit programs
limitation: Hardening broke 32-bit binaries (moby/moby#52506 per Docker blog) and was replaced five days later; mitigation does not fix the kernel flaw

source_title: Docker Engine 29 release notes: 29.4.3
claim_summary: Replaced the socketcall seccomp deny with AppArmor and SELinux rules blocking AF_ALG for CVE-2026-31431; Docker Desktop 4.72.0 the same day backported the upstream kernel patch
limitation: Protection depends on host AppArmor/SELinux enforcement; on hosts without either the socketcall path stays open; the real fix is a patched host kernel (Docker blog 2026-05-27)

source_title: Docker AI Governance: Unlock Agent Autonomy, Safely
claim_summary: Vendor describes a central control plane for agent network/filesystem policy, credential scoping, MCP tool allow-listing, IdP-assigned policy groups and SIEM-exportable audit events; says available now via contact sales
availability: vendor says available; GA/preview label and plan not stated
limitation: Sales-gated; no public plan matrix, independent test or customer evidence; enforcement claims not exercised

source_title: Meet Gordon: Docker's AI Agent For Your Entire Container Workflow
claim_summary: Gordon declared generally available (Desktop 4.74+ or docker ai CLI) with a free tier and paid add-on plans; each shell command, file change and Docker operation shown for approval; session-scoped permissions; optional auto-approve
availability: GA per vendor; usage limits by plan
limitation: Privacy/retention and capacity statements are vendor claims; auto-approve weakens the approval checkpoint; Desktop 4.74.0 also disabled Docker Extensions by default

source_title: Error in Docker Model Runner allows sandbox escape on macOS
claim_summary: Independent outlet reports CVE-2026-5843: a malicious model config can make the macOS MLX backend execute bundled Python outside any sandbox; fixed in 4.71.0; no attacks reported
limitation: Independent publisher but relies on advisory text; no independent reproduction; CVSS scores differ across aggregators

source_title: Docker joins the Athena coalition: a cross-industry collaboration for supply chain security
claim_summary: Docker says it is a founding participant in a coalition for coordinated pre-disclosure defense of open source as AI accelerates vulnerability discovery
availability: membership announced; no deliverables or dates stated
limitation: No member list, deliverables, timeline or funding in the post; membership is not evidence of security outcomes

source_title: Docker Content Trust: Retirement and Migration Guidance
claim_summary: Full retirement of DCT and notary.docker.io: write brownouts Jul 14-15, read brownouts Aug 10 and 12, full shutdown Dec 8 2026; migrate to digest pinning plus Sigstore/Cosign or Notation, enforced via Kyverno or Ratify
limitation: Shutdown date lies after the window; vendor states under 0.05% of Hub pulls rely on DCT (not independently checked); publishers must re-sign themselves

source_title: Docker Desktop release notes: 4.80.0
claim_summary: The experimental docker sandbox plugin was removed from Docker Desktop (summary of notes: migrate to the standalone sbx CLI); legacy osxfs file sharing also removed
limitation: Removal of an experimental interface; scripts relying on docker sandbox need migration; migration cost not measured

source_title: Docker Desktop release notes: 4.81.0
claim_summary: Release notes: removed the deprecated cagent binary from Docker Desktop; use docker agent instead
limitation: Rename/removal only; docker agent capabilities and license not assessed here

source_title: Docker Engine 29 release notes: 29.7.0
claim_summary: Fixed CVE-2026-17106 by updating go-archive to v0.3.0; added experimental embedded-containerd feature; Docker Desktop 4.86.0 (2026-08-10) lists the same CVE as a docker container cp destination-escape flaw
limitation: 29.7.1 and 29.7.2 followed with regression fixes for symlink/hardlink handling; no independent exploit test

source_title: The Future of Agentic AI Depends on Openness and Trust. That's Why Docker Is Joining Nvidia's Open Secure AI Alliance.
claim_summary: Docker announces joining NVIDIA's Open Secure AI Alliance, framing goals as deterministic agent control, model choice and trusted execution environments
limitation: No specific commitments, outputs or dates; membership is not adoption or security evidence

product: Docker Hub OIDC for GitHub Actions
source_title: Docker OIDC connections for GitHub Actions available for Docker Orgs
claim_summary: GitHub Actions workflows can authenticate to Docker Hub with short-lived per-run OIDC tokens via docker/login-action v4.5.0+ instead of stored PATs/OATs; up to five rulesets per connection
availability: available to Team, Business, DHI and DSOS orgs; not Personal/Pro
limitation: GitHub Actions only; plan-gated; repos created after 2026-07-15 use immutable-ID subject claims; GA/beta label not stated

source_title: Docker Desktop release notes: 4.86.0
claim_summary: Added a three-mode safety system (Strict, Balanced, Autonomous) to Gordon's tool-confirmation UI; also addressed CVE-2026-17106 in docker container cp
limitation: Mode semantics and default not independently tested; Autonomous mode reduces human checkpoints

source_title: Docker VMM Public Beta: A Complete Overhaul, Built for Performance
claim_summary: Docker VMM public beta on macOS and Windows with Desktop 4.86+; claims faster startup and file I/O; GA targeted end of October 2026 as default engine for new installs, Linux at GA
availability: public beta; GA is a target
limitation: No benchmark numbers or method published; GA target falls after window and is not a commitment

source_title: Docker Strengthens Leadership Team With Appointments of Mat Velloso as Chief Product Officer and Vinh Le as Chief Financial Officer
claim_summary: Docker, Inc. appoints Mat Velloso (CPO) and Vinh Le (CFO); release positions Docker as a platform for building software in the agentic era
limitation: Press release says nothing about ownership, investors or financial results; executive hires are not product evidence

source_title: Docker Agentic Platform release notes: August 26, 2026 initial release
claim_summary: Release notes record an initial release of isolated cloud sandboxes for agents (predefined types incl. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Gemini CLI), 1-24 hour timer, per-second compute billing, secrets stored outside sandboxes and deny-over-allow network policies
availability: initial release; access scope not stated; same notes label 2026-09-24 an experimental public release
limitation: Initial-release date precedes public launch by four weeks; audience/plan of the Aug 26 release unresolved

source_title: Docker Launches Cloud Sandboxes, Extending Secure AI Agent Isolation Beyond the Laptop
claim_summary: Cloud Sandboxes run agents with the same microVM isolation, CLI, policies and Kits as local sandboxes on Docker-managed compute (1-16 vCPU); blog lists pay-as-you-go pricing USD 0.07-1.12 per hour, 1 h default and 24 h max session; sbx move transfers filesystem between local and cloud
availability: vendor says available today; Agentic Platform notes call it an experimental public release
limitation: Isolation and boot-time claims unverified; filesystem move is not process migration; promotional free credit time-limited; enterprise governance stated as coming soon

source_title: Docker and CNCF partner on an open spec for agent permissions
claim_summary: Docker publishes the Sandbox Kit Specification (agent, tools and access rules packaged as OCI images) under Apache-2.0 at github.com/docker/sandbox-kit-spec and says it is bringing the spec to CNCF neutral governance
availability: spec published (repo marks it experimental, final targeted Q4 2026); CNCF transfer announced only
limitation: No CNCF acceptance or maturity level documented in window; DevOps.com reports Docker Sandboxes is the only conforming runtime; GitHub API: repo created 2026-09-16, license Apache-2.0

source_title: Docker's new sandboxes aim to contain AI agents for real
claim_summary: Reporter relays launch at WeAreDevelopers, a vendor-staged demo where an agent could reach a mounted Docker socket in a standard container but not in a sandbox, pricing tiers, and Docker's own caveat that sandboxes are only the deterministic base layer
limitation: Independent publisher but no independent test; demo was staged by Docker; same event as the press release, not separate confirmation

source_title: Docker Desktop release notes: 4.93.0
claim_summary: Fixed Enhanced Container Isolation not being enforced on an engine left running while another was in use; fixed a vulnerability allowing VM-side code to request Unix socket port forwards
limitation: Vendor-disclosed isolation gap; exposure window and affected versions not stated in the summary read; no CVE identified in the text read

source_title: add AI Policy (docker/compose PR #13550)
claim_summary: Compose adds AI_POLICY.md (merged 2026-09-29): AI use disclosed in the PR description, human contributor responsible for and reviews all output, scoped PRs only on maintainer-approved issues; final commit adopts the centralized moby/.github AI usage policy; shipped in Compose v5.6.0 (2026-10-02)
limitation: Policy text, not enforcement evidence; final wording read only via PR review and commit messages; effect on review burden unmeasured

source_title: Docker Engine 29 release notes: 29.8.2
claim_summary: Fixed Engine CVE-2026-53493, CVE-2026-92543 (TLS verification bypass via DNS) and CVE-2026-92542 (forged frames on encrypted overlay networks), plus BuildKit CVE-2026-93315 through CVE-2026-93326
limitation: CVE details read only via release-note summary; severity and exploitability not independently checked

source_title: Docker Desktop release notes: 4.94.0
claim_summary: Fixed stored API keys being written in clear to Docker Desktop logs and included in diagnostics bundles; default logging driver for new Linux containers changed to local (log rotation)
limitation: Affected versions and whether diagnostics were uploaded not stated in text read; users may need to rotate keys

source_title: Docker Hub security advisory: personal access tokens transferred during account-to-organization conversions
claim_summary: CISO advisory: from 2024-08-26 until fix on 2026-09-30 converting an account to an organization reassigned its PATs to the named owner without rotation, letting an attacker keep a token authenticating to the registry as the target; transferred PATs deactivated 2026-10-08; vendor reports no evidence of exploitation after reviewing about 304,000 pushes
availability: fixed server-side; user action for notified accounts
limitation: No-exploitation finding is vendor self-assessment; unused tokens leave no logs; BleepingComputer (2026-10-13, outside window) relays the advisory without independent testing
